# @major-tech/app-client

Fetch-compatible client for calling another Major app from a deployed Major app.

## Usage

Add a client for the target app (baked with its app ID):

```bash
npx major-app-client add <app_id> "Order Service" --framework nextjs
```

This generates `clients/orderService.ts`:

```ts
import 'server-only';
import { createAppFetch } from '@major-tech/app-client/next';

/**
 * Order Service
 * App ID: <app_id>
 * DO NOT EDIT - Auto-generated by @major-tech/app-client
 */
export const orderServiceFetch = createAppFetch({
  baseUrl: process.env.MAJOR_API_BASE_URL || 'https://go-api.prod.major.build',
  appId: '<app_id>',
  majorJwtToken: process.env.MAJOR_JWT_TOKEN!,
});
```

Call the target app with it:

```ts
import { orderServiceFetch } from './clients';

const res = await orderServiceFetch('/api/orders?status=open');
const orders = await res.json();
```

`orderServiceFetch` resolves the target app's URL through go-api, then sends
the visitor's JWT to it as `x-major-jwt` so the target app can authorize the call.
The app's own `MAJOR_JWT_TOKEN` is only used for the URL lookup and never reaches the target.

## CLI

```bash
major-app-client add <app_id> <name> [description] [--framework <nextjs|vite>]
major-app-client remove <name> [--framework <nextjs|vite>]
major-app-client list
```

Use `--framework vite` for non-Next.js apps: the generated client imports the
root `@major-tech/app-client` entry and reads `import.meta.env` instead of
`process.env`.
